featured_reviews.name: ashok mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
Happy experience...
Thanks doctors....

Yes my friends,
People write many nasty experience they face in hospital or with doctors. Very few write their sweet experiences in hospital or with doctors.

So I thought to share my excellent sweet experience with a small, faraway hospital but with exceptional expertise in the field of knee replacement and other orthopedic and neurological complication.

My wife Operated for knee replacement on 15th...At 11 in the morning (to 2.30 pm) including recovery time inside operation theatre...

Then shifted to ICU.
Operation was good, my wife was in jolly mood and smiling while coming out from OT after the replacement ... But after 2 hrs of shifting to ICU, the real pain started... Wife was crying like mad for pain... But through medication by 8 pm it has started reducing... and she slept.
Nxt day, 16th, morning no pain...and shifted to pvt room cabin. I also staying in the same room with her. Excellent clean cosy room with all necessary requirements like AC, TV, eye catching view from 4th floor Window, attached very clean bath (no balcony), clean and daily fresh linen.

17th.. Sr Doctors and physiotherapist started her to walk and bent the new knee to 90°...

This was regular exercise, bending knee to 90° and walking in the corridor with the help of walker and physiotherapist till 19th...

And on 19th all bandage and all drain-pipes ( 3 in total... For Blood to drain our excess blood at operated knee, one for urine, one at spinal joint to push different medicine ) removed and....
discharged in the afternoon by doctor...
Same day, 19th, came to home by evening.

She is recovering nicely.... Walking inside the flat with the help of walker... pain she feel very very rarely.

After 9th day from operation, today (24th March) was the first check up...and it is absolutely OK.
Infact, my wife walk through out the day in hospital alone with the help of walker.
Today, she has been allowed by doctor to move and do morning/evening walk with walker and asked for further check up after 15 days.
No medicine given except multivitamin for further recovery as she has no pain.

We are very very happy for the excellent smooth operation, expertise of doctors, quick recovery process with effective treatment, support of Jr. Doctors, Physiotherapist, Metron, Sisters, Brothers, room boy and aayas for 24×7 and overall management of the hospital.

Well behaved people....
No extra billing...

We, and no one, before surgery, expected that after operation on 2nd day pain would vanish... she would walk and bend knee to 90°and get discharge on 4th day...!!!

All credit goes to Dr. Rahul Bade and his team including Anesthesists Dr. Ganesh Kolhe at Sparsh Multi-Speciality Hospital.

Thank you...well done, doctor !!!
🙏🙏🙏

Thanks to Lt. Col Dr Amogh Yadav from Mumbai and Dr. Rahul Mane for strongly recomanding us the hospital.

(Note : Treatment was going on at Sanchiti Hospital. But operated at Sparsh Multi Speciality Hospital)

featured_reviews.name: Waseem Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
In 2018, my mother was diagnosed with cancer, and we began her treatment at various hospitals in Pune. We went through everything—surgery, chemotherapy, and the many challenges that come with such a difficult journey. Unfortunately, in 2020, despite all our efforts, the cancer returned.
To make things even harder, 2020 was the peak of the COVID-19 pandemic. Visiting hospitals itself was extremely difficult due to restrictions, safety risks, and limited medical access. During this stressful time, my cousin introduced us to Dr. Fayyaz. From the very first meeting, he became a tremendous source of support and guidance.
He connected us with some of the best doctors in Asia at Lilavati Hospital, and despite his busy schedule, he always made time to guide us through each step of my mother's treatment. He recommended the right specialists, the best hospitals, and ensured that we received quality care within our budget. His help during COVID—especially when accessing medical care was so challenging—was truly a blessing.
Dr. Fayyaz has a heart of gold. His dedication, compassion, and sincere efforts made a world of difference to our family. I wholeheartedly wish him all the very best for the future.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you so much for sharing your heartfelt experience 🙏

We are truly honored by your kind words about Dr. Fayyaz. Supporting patients and their families during such challenging times—especially during COVID—was our responsibility and commitment.

Your trust means everything to us. We sincerely wish your mother strength, health, and peace. Thank you for choosing Namra Medical Tourism.

featured_reviews.name: Bhavna Makhija
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a really good experience at ozone multi-speciality Hospital. The facilities are well maintained, and the services are good. The doctors and nurses are extremely professional, caring, and attentive. Every day they personally checked if there was any inconvenience in the room or if I needed anything.
The housekeeping staff is also very punctual and efficient... they cleaned and visited the room around 3–4 times a day, which made the stay feel hygienic and comfortable. The food was decent as well.
I was admitted here for treatment and honestly found the entire process very convenient, smooth, and stress-free.

Overall, I would definitely recommend this hospital for their care, cleanliness, and supportive staff.

featured_reviews.review_text: My father was admitted to Ozone Multispeciality Hospital and we had a very positive experience. We are truly grateful for the best treatment and care given to my father. Thank you to the entire hospital staff for their dedication and compassion.

featured_reviews.name: aditya Vishwakarma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ozone Hospital is very good, and the doctors are excellent. My mother is currently undergoing treatment here for liver cirrhosis with ascites.

The doctors, the entire nursing team, and the support staff have shown outstanding dedication, compassion, and hospitality. Their ability to deeply understand patient concerns and address them with empathy is truly admirable. The discharge process is as smooth and efficient as the admission, reflecting their strong patient-first approach.

We truly appreciate Ozone Hospital. It is very well managed with highly qualified staff. All the treatments, tests, and checkups were well coordinated. I am extremely happy with the hospitality and the caring nature of the staff. The doctors are also amazing.

A special thanks to Dr. Ganesh Sir and Dr. Atul Sir, whose deep understanding, care, and commitment to providing an excellent patient experience deserve great appreciation.

featured_reviews.name: Nisha Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to Dr. Ganesh Sir and his entire team. My mother-in-law was admitted to the hospital, and she received excellent care and treatment there.
The entire staff is very cooperative, kind, and highly professional. They supported us at every step, which gave us a lot of comfort during a difficult time.
Dr. Ganesh Sir himself is very humble and down-to-earth. His caring nature and dedication towards his patients are truly commendable. I am genuinely thankful for all the support and cooperation he provided.

featured_reviews.name: Chetan Kolge
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ozone Multispeciality Hospital provides outstanding medical care with a very professional and caring staff. The doctors are highly knowledgeable and take time to explain everything clearly. The hospital is clean, well-maintained, and well-organized, from OPD to diagnostics and pharmacy services.
The staff is polite, supportive, and always ready to help, making patients feel comfortable and safe. Diagnostic services are quick and accurate, and the chemist is well-stocked, which is very convenient.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for reliable, quality healthcare under one roof.

featured_reviews.name: Irfan Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
We brought our 9-year-old daughter to Ozone Multispeciality Hospital in a very serious condition with severe breathlessness. She was referred from another hospital, and the moment we reached the casualty, the doctors immediately diagnosed her condition as DKA and shifted her to the ICCU without wasting a second.

The paediatric team provided exceptional critical care, and every step of her treatment was timely and well-coordinated. They even arranged for a paediatric endocrinologist from Mumbai specially for our daughter, which shows their dedication and commitment towards patient care.

Today, she is discharged in good condition, and we are extremely relieved and grateful. The Doctors have also guided us thoroughly about the further management of her Type 1 Diabetes, which has given us a lot of confidence for the future.

We are highly obliged to Ozone Multispeciality Hospital and its entire team for saving our child and supporting us throughout this difficult journey. We wholeheartedly recommend this hospital to anyone in need of quality and compassionate medical care.
